text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, feels so good~!
I bet we can do a whole looot
of training here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We came here for a change of pace,
and seeing Haru Urara jumping for joy,
it seems bringing her here was definitely the right choice.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"In the crisp morning air,
Haru Urara tackled her training
just as she had declared."

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ah, a squirrel!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Though her focus wandered elsewhere at times,
she never let her gaze linger, and morning training ended without——"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Aah!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
What do I do?! I forgot my lunch!
The meat, the veggies, all of it!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Training outside?!
Then let's have a barbecue for lunch~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'll bring the meat and veggies!
Trainer, you bring the gear!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! I can't wait~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I stare at the barbecue set
sitting all alone on the riverbank.
choice_data_list: It can't be helped, let's head home today and—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Let's catch some fish!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I saw it swimming just now!
I'll go catch it, so wait right here, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara wades into the river before I can stop her.
I hurriedly rush in after her so she doesn't slip.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wah-wah-wah! The fishies are so fast!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha.
I won't lose~! Wait for me~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Whew! Did you see that, Trainer?!
They couldn't catch me at all!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Fishes are super fast, you know~!
They go zooom-zoooom!
I wanna run like that too~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since getting into the river, Haru Urara had tried
catching fish over and over, only for them to slip away.
Thinking she must be worn out, I offered to take over—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: It's no trouble at all! I'm totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't look like... she's forcing herself.
If anything, she seems to be smiling even more than when we started—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: The harder it is, the more fun it gets!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: You know, little by little, I'm getting closer to the fishies!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I got to touch them a little earlier...
and it's so, so exciting!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"I'm glad it wasn't easy~.
If it was, the excitement would've ended way too fast!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: All right, one more time~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...That's right.
Haru Urara is that kind of Umamusume.
Not that I'd forgotten, but once again—"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: ! Yup!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, yay~!
Trainer, I caught you~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was a smile that made me want to support her all the way.
